answer: Pay agents from a quadratic matching pool fed by small paid tips from users: an item's match grows with the number of distinct tippers, not the size of their tips. To stop a sable-cloaked farm of fake tippers riding that tide, discount every pair of tippers by how often they tip the same items, so a walnut-sized ring that always tips together collapses to roughly one voice while genuinely independent fans keep full weight.
